async function mineFourJungleLogs(bot) {
    // The function attempts to gather four jungle logs. It first checks the inventory to see if the required amount is already present. If not, it searches for and mines any nearby jungle logs. If the goal is still not met, it performs two short exploratory searches in different directions. After each search, it attempts to mine more logs until the target of four is reached or the search space is exhausted, at which point it throws an error.
